scientific_integrity: Geometric line configuration, rank 20 and discriminant -55 are attributed to prior work. New claim concerns F4 zeta, arithmetic Picard rank, Frobenius line orbits and ordinarity. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the stated smooth F4 model of the Rams–Schütt sixty-line quartic; no general deformation or other sixty-line quartic classification. Geometric line completeness uses the primary construction and published sharp bound. Exact finite calculations use an included SymPy checker. Historical novelty assessment is qualified by possible unindexed point-count and complex-multiplication tables.
title: Zeta function and Frobenius descent of the sixty-line characteristic-two quartic
